name: V3 BigBang Orion canonical roster persistence
description: Checks the full migrated Orion roster in a disposable BigBang world before test_rig replaces world records.

tests.name: Authenticate in the isolated BigBang world
At least 100 distinct named Orion NPC identities persist as faction members

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>=100 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.name)>=100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN corp_members cm ON cm.player_id=p.player_id JOIN corporations c ON c.corporation_id=cm.corporation_id WHERE c.tag='ORION' AND p.is_npc=TRUE;
